suggestions.suggestion: Nonblocking hardening: create capture and receipt outputs exclusively rather than checking existence before ordinary writes, eliminating a concurrent-writer overwrite race.

Add CPU negative tests for CPP.failed, changed-session focus mismatch, and capture rejection for existing evidence and protected save/pack paths. These guards exist, but current tests do not exercise all of them.

summary: No blocking correctness or security bug found. Reviewed every staged Python diff and all new manifests/descriptor without dumping mesh payloads. All 16 focused CPU tests passed with fresh TMPDIR; real AssetResolver tests validated the seven replacements, mesh hashes, budgets and unaffected neighbouring bindings. Independently SHA-256 checked 626 baseline files across runtime/source/assets and accepted packs against fd3368e: zero changes. All staged files matched working-tree bytes, security-pattern scan was clean, and cached whitespace checks passed. Launcher executes current main.py, isolates settings/saves/replays and copied packs, rejects missing/rejected replacements, and counts successful native presents without introducing a legacy fallback. No repository files modified; no Blender, main, GPU or installation run. This permits asset-task handover only, not merge, owner appearance approval, organic-construction acceptance or FPS claims.
